items.form: A ladder # m long leans on a wall and makes an angle of \(#^\circ\) with the ground. How high does it reach (in metres)?
items.en: A ladder 10 m long leans on a wall and makes an angle of \(30^\circ\) with the ground. How high does it reach (in metres)?

items.explain_en: Answer: c. Height \(=10\sin 30^\circ=5\) m.
items.explain_vi: Đáp án c. Độ cao \(=10\sin 30^\circ=5\) m.
